about: Computation engines that are programs on the user's computer (desktop app only): python is SymPy by the Python that comes with opensw (without it SymPy runs in Pyodide, as in a browser), the others are programs the user has. How to add one: ENGINE.md. A file name here is in this folder (engine/); program: where to look for the program, the newest version found is used (* is any folder name), a bare name is looked for on the PATH, {engine} at the start is this folder (a program that comes with opensw). In args and load, {adapter} is the adapter file's full path and {adapter64} the same in base64; in call, {op} is the operation and {data} the request in base64.
